about_the_game:
Treachery lies in every corner.

When your village is burned to the ground, you're left fleeing with a disgraced prince exiled from his own kingdom. Your father’s dying wish was to protect him, but is he truly worth saving?

In a war-torn realm where loyalty is fleeting and power comes at a cost, navigate shifting alliances, political intrigue, and buried secrets to survive. Will you flee from your past or embrace the fate that awaits you?

Features:

  • Make impactful choices that shape the story and your relationships.

  • Play as male or female with customisation in key scenes.

  • Romance or befriend one of five major characters.

  • Uncover your character’s hidden past and legacy.

  • Assist the exiled prince—or claim your own power.

  • Navigate political alliances, betrayal, and war.

  • Mature themes: violence, optional sexual content, and strong language.

  • Story-first design: stats influence outcomes, but narrative comes first.

Romanceable Characters and Key Allies:

  • Prince Irus (he/him) – The illegitimate son of a dead king. Inexperienced, ambitious, and convinced he deserves the crown.

  • Queen Elora (she/her) – The ruler of Vinia. Beautiful and charming, with a ruthless mind for strategy.

  • Sir Oren (he/him) – Captain of the Vinian Royal Guard. Stoic, dutiful, and slow to trust—but fiercely loyal once won.

  • Anu (she/her) – A Priestess of Ehulla. Passionate, fearless, and driven by her conviction that peace can only come through war.

  • Dena (gender selectable - he/him, she/her) – A childhood friend turned sea captain. Suave, cunning, and willing to do anything for power.

Additional Info:

  • Written in UK English

  • Limited gender selection (male/female); body variation supported in NSFW scenes

  • DLC content planned after full release—narratively optional but world-expanding

  • Over 1 million words in total

content_descriptors.notes: Note: Crown of Exile contains optional romantic content. Players can choose either fade-to-black or explicit scenes depending on preference. All explicit scenes can be skipped. No visual nudity or explicit artwork is included.

name: Crown of Exile
short_description: The realms are fractured. A kingdom burns. In this dark fantasy interactive tale, you flee with an exiled prince through a land of treachery and fading deities. Will you shape your fate in blood and fire, or vanish beneath the weight of secrets best left buried?
